headline: Ultima sensors proven sub-region; builder board runs dry
lede: Slot b shipped the DOSSENSORS sub-region reaction proof for Ultima (#1463). Slot a walked the full ladder against a live board — no claimable queue items, QA holds its feedback, and every flagship README gap is now CLOSED-marked — so the builder idles honestly while the studio still ships.

notes.text: Ultima's DOS-sensor arm now proves reaction per sub-region, not just per screen — a dead pixel region can no longer hide inside an overall pass (#1463, PR #1470).

The builder ladder was walked live: halt/steer/next/game-queue empty, both feedback items held by live QA sessions, and flagshipStage derives null from the four flagship READMEs at HEAD — every honest gap carries a CLOSED marker.
#1456 (STALLED, AWAITING until Nov 4) is the one lever: what builder lanes should self-commission next. Until then the loop holds idle by default rather than inventing work.
